translations.english: "Those vanaras having entered Madhuvanam and broken the trees are quite right. Had they not accomplished their purpose they would not have indulged themselves that way.
translations.hindi: है भ्ररिन्दम ! वह भयभीत हो फिर तुम्हारे पास श्राया हे शरणदाता ! वह पृथिवी पर गिर तुम्हारे शरण हुआ
